newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian newspaper editor gunned down.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian newspaper editor gunned down.

text.p: The editor of a Phnom Penh newspaper was shot in the stomach by an unidentified gunman late on Thursday and was in a stable condition, colleagues and police said on Friday.

Leng Samnang, 26, was pulled from a car as he returned home from a birthday party for co-Premier Prince Norodom Ranariddh at about 10.30 pm (1530 GMT). Seven uniformed men surrounded the editor, who was beaten and shot, said the publisher of his newspaper, Kumnith Kaun Khmer, or "Idea of Cambodia's Children".
Publisher Cheng Sokna said the attack followed months of intimidation and threats and seemed to suggest it had been politically motivated.
"Frankly speaking, I criticised the CPP directly," he said, referring to co-Premier Hun Sen's ex-communist Cambodian People's Party.
The attack on Leng Sokna, who is married with three children, follows reports of threats to several journalists and the unsolved murders of three journalists in the past two years.
